visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman is captured in a full-body shot, cosplaying as the character Tatsumaki. She wears a vibrant, curly green wig and matching green contact lenses that enlarge her eyes. Her outfit is a long-sleeved, high-collared black dress with exceptionally high slits on both sides, revealing her legs and black high heels. A TikTok comment bubble from 'Minnie' is physically overlaid in the center of the frame, showing black text on a white background. The setting is a simple indoor corner with white walls and a wooden floor, illuminated by a strong green light that casts a dramatic, sharp shadow on the wall. (2) The comment overlay disappears from the screen. The character begins to move rhythmically to the background music, shifting her weight from side to side and swaying her hips. She maintains a serious, slightly annoyed facial expression with a small pout, consistent with the character's persona. She places her hands on her hips, accentuating the silhouette of her black dress and the height of the leg slits. The camera remains static at eye-level, focusing on her stylized movements and the specific textures of her costume. (3) A new text overlay appears in the center, featuring green-and-white stylized font with a red anger vein emoji. The cosplayer continues her rhythmic posing, beckoning the viewer closer with a finger curl gesture before crossing her arms over her chest in a defiant posture. She looks directly into the lens with a piercing, steady gaze. The lighting remains a stark mix of white front-lighting and green background-lighting throughout the phase.
